question: Should ClawHub/OpenClaw still support the legacy `https://molt.bot/install.sh` zsh installer, or should that path redirect or retire in favor of current install commands?
rationale: The failing implementation is outside current main while current docs and UI point to maintained install flows, so automation cannot safely choose the support boundary.

options.title: Redirect or retire legacy installer
options.body: Point legacy `molt.bot` users to the maintained OpenClaw/ClawHub install commands and document the supported Node range.

options.title: Support and harden legacy installer
options.body: Bring the installer source under ownership, reproduce the macOS/Homebrew zsh failure, and guard unmatched cleanup globs.

options.title: Wait for fresh reproduction
options.body: Keep the issue waiting on author until there is evidence that a currently supported installer path still fails.

recommendation.title: Redirect or retire legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point legacy `molt.bot` users to the maintained OpenClaw/ClawHub install commands and document the supported Node range.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the clearest current in-repo owner for the maintained CLI/package install surface, even though the legacy hosted script itself is absent.
